cohort: 32,464 singleton term births in Nova Scotia, Canada between 2003 and 2007
finding: Children born by cesarean delivery had slightly increased healthcare utilization and costs during the first 7 years of life compared to those born vaginally.
mod_finding: The study found that children born by cesarean delivery had slightly increased healthcare utilization and costs during the first 7 years of life compared to those born vaginally.
